import copy,json,py_compile
from work import evaluate
py_compile.compile('work.py',doraise=True)
with open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)
expected=[]
for request in requests:
    before_request=copy.deepcopy(request); before_policy=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    expected.append(evaluate(request,policy))
    assert request==before_request and policy==before_policy
assert report==expected,(report,expected)
cases=[
({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':1},'b':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':2,'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),
({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['x']}),
({'declared':['x'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'b':2,'a':1}},'current':{'x':{'a':1,'b':2}}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'z':1},'current':{'z':2}},{},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]
for request,policy,want in cases:
    assert evaluate(request,policy)==want
print('verified',len(requests),'report rows and',len(cases),'edge cases')
